scope: The documented stronger-focus preference reaches three existing custom controls
repairs: A private lazy helper reuses theme.FOCUS_RING_PX and focus_ring_colour for the effective theme; no new public API/caption.
Figure cells, montage crops and the Clear figures control cache this policy at construction and refresh on Qt StyleChange/PaletteChange.
Painting uses the cache; get_strong_focus is never read by the new paint path.
Stronger focus gives the three controls the same three-pixel contrast-checked theme outline. Turning it off restores their ordinary rings.
A montage crop retains one ring: its ordinary border is suppressed only while focused with stronger focus enabled. Crop geometry, candidate identity and resting/hover behavior are preserved.
validation: Nine real pixel cases cover all three controls in Dark, Light and High contrast.

Each control is already shown and focused before the real isolated preference store is toggled on and off. Applying the existing _the_focus_ring stylesheet triggers actual Qt style changes; constructor-only caching cannot pass.
Tests require exact three-pixel theme-color top borders, unchanged inner content, unchanged unfocused appearance and exact restoration after disabling.
Three cases reject any get_strong_focus read during paint.
Existing keyboard activation/identity, accessible names, mouse routing, crop-data preservation, hover rings, clear behavior and shared click-flash tests pass unchanged.

environment.coordination: Coordinator-approved bounded measured light lane, no heavy.lock; each run peaked below 668000 KiB.

api_reason: The helper and all changed control classes are private and excluded by the normal public_docstrings collector.
limits: This closes the identified three-control preference inconsistency, not full N655 or every possible custom control.
Shared theme/preferences sources and native control styling were not modified.
